parameters.help_en: The region where the data lake resides
parameters.name: data_region

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.

To view the tenant ID, hover over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en: A regular expression used to filter function names
parameters.help_zh: 函数名匹配的正则表达式，用于过滤返回的函数名称
parameters.name: function_name_pattern

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. If the response to a previous request is truncated, you can use this token to retrieve the next page of results.

If NextToken is empty, there is no next query.

If a value is returned for NextToken, that value is the token for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100
parameters.name: max_results
